title: QUEST: Training Frontier Deep Research Agents with Fully Synthetic Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2605.24218v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep research agents extend the role of search engines from retrieving keyword-matched pages to synthesizing knowledge, fundamentally changing how humans interact with information. However, frontier systems remain proprietary, while existing open agents often generalize poorly across different task types, leaving unclear how to train a broadly capable deep research agent. We release QUEST, a family of open models (ranging from 2B to 35B) that serve as general-purpose deep research agents designed to handle a wide range of long-horizon search tasks, with strong capabilities in fact seeking, citation grounding, and report synthesis. To build QUEST, we propose an effective training recipe combining mid-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning. translated_title: QUEST：用完全合成的任务训练前沿深度研究智能体
translated_abstract: 深度研究智能体将搜索引擎的角色从检索关键词匹配的网页扩展到综合整理知识，从根本上改变了人类与信息交互的方式。然而，前沿系统仍然是闭源专有的，而现有的开源智能体在不同任务类型之间往往泛化能力较差，因此如何训练出一个具备广泛能力的深度研究智能体仍不明确。我们发布了QUEST，这是一系列开源模型（参数规模从2B到35B），作为通用的深度研究智能体，旨在处理多种长程搜索任务，在事实检索、引用溯源和报告综合方面具有强大的能力。为了构建QUEST，我们提出了一种有效的训练方案，将中期训练、监督微调和强化学习相结合。该方案的核心是一条精心设计的数据合成流水线，其基于统一的评分准则树（rubric trees），可适用于不同的任务类型，并能够合成带有可验证……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: QUEST 是一系列开源通用深度研究智能体模型（2B至35B），其核心创新在于基于统一评分准则树的全合成数据流水线，配合中期训练、监督微调与强化学习的训练方案，使其在事实检索、引用溯源和报告综合等多种长程搜索任务上表现出色。
en_tdlr: QUEST is a family of open general-purpose deep research agent models (2B to 35B) whose key contribution is a fully synthetic data pipeline built on unified rubric trees, combined with mid-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning, enabling strong performance across diverse long-horizon search tasks including fact seeking, citation grounding, and report synthesis.
